title.narrative: Consolidating malaria control achievements in Togo - Togo (01-Jan-2021-31-Dec-2023)

description.narrative: Togo, Malaria, Secrétariat Général du Gouvernement (SGG)This program has the following goals: Significantly reduce the burden of malaria by 2023. The objectives of this program are: Reduce the incidence of malaria by at least 50% compared to 2015. Reduce the malaria mortality rate by at least 40% compared to 2015. Strengthen and maintain programme management capacity at all levels by 2023
